papers.title: TARE Expressivity
papers.current_ceiling: The complete local obstruction classification kappa_R6M=2 is retained; the global-basis successor is ungradable.
post_matrix_updates: The 5,005-row census and its protocol/checker were recovered to main, closing a reproducibility hole but not the checker disagreement.
load_bearing_adverse: The full 5,005-instance census terminal is CANNOT_CHECK__CHECKER_DISAGREEMENT.
The independent checker recovers planted positives that the runner misses.
Because the control gate failed, the global obstruction basis cannot be graded from that run.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: Before any new global claim, the runner/checker semantic disagreement must be localized on known controls, the intended predicate must be authoritatively specified, and a new frozen census identity must be created.
papers.decisive_question: Which predicate implementation matches the formal TARE obstruction definition on an exhaustive diagnostic control suite, and under that repaired specification is there a finite global obstruction basis on the new frozen universe?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: A globally valid finite obstruction-basis theorem, or a minimal family proving that no proposed finite basis is complete over the frozen universe.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: First prove runner/checker equivalence to a declarative reference predicate on all diagnostic controls; only then test whether every obstruction in the prospectively frozen census reduces to the declared basis.
papers.population_or_universe: Phase A: all synthetically generated predicate atoms and minimal composites within a frozen small grammar. Phase B: a new, outcome-disjoint global census universe.
papers.unit_of_analysis: A diagnostic predicate instance in phase A; a TARE instance and its minimal obstruction in phase B.
historical_only_inputs: The accessed 5,005 census rows and their old terminal
design: Build a third declarative reference implementation from the formal definitions, not from runner or checker code.
Exhaust all small predicate combinations and delta-debug every disagreement.
Adjudicate the intended semantics before creating V2.
Freeze a new universe, basis, reduction rule and decision order under a new identity.
Use two independent graders and require control agreement before any scientific terminal.
primary_endpoints: Three-way agreement on all diagnostic controls.
Number and minimal form of semantic disagreement classes.
Global basis completeness on the new universe.
negative_controls: Every planted positive/negative from the old control gate.
Boundary cases where one syntactic token changes the truth value.
Malformed or under-specified instances that must yield CANNOT_CHECK.
analysis_plan: Phase A is exhaustive and exact.
Phase B reports exact census coverage, timeouts and independent-grader agreement.
The old 5,005 outcomes may be used only to define adverse-history checks, never to choose the V2 basis or gate.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Exhaust the full phase-A grammar and the entire prospectively pinned phase-B universe; no sampled positive claim.
papers.success_gate: All three predicate implementations agree on phase A, both frozen V2 graders agree, and every V2 obstruction carries a valid reduction to the basis.
papers.refutation_gate: Any V2 obstruction without a valid reduction disproves completeness; unresolved phase-A disagreement blocks the census rather than favouring either old implementation.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if the formal predicate cannot distinguish the old disagreements, controls do not all pass or V2 has unresolved timeout/serialization gaps.
papers.authority_required: Formal-specification adjudication plus two independent implementations; no external institution is needed for the finite theorem, but the semantics must be authoritatively fixed.

active_lane.collision_rule: Coordinate with #1694; do not edit or rerun its frozen identity, and do not create V2 until the predicate adjudication is recorded.

immediate_safe_actions: Construct the exhaustive phase-A disagreement minimizer on controls only.
Write an adjudication table mapping each disagreement to the formal clause.
Prepare a V2 protocol template with every outcome-dependent field blank.
forbidden_actions: Do not regrade the old 5,005 rows after changing an instrument.
Do not count complete row presence as a valid scientific terminal when controls fail.
Do not weaken or remove planted controls.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier discrete-methods paper needs an exact global theorem or sharp counterexample, a trusted declarative semantics, independent graders and full census receipts.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns TARE obstruction expressivity; generic method-language expansion belongs to ORION-20.
